questions.text: When you pluck a guitar string, what makes the sound?
options: The string vibrates back and forth
questions.explanation: Sound is made when something vibrates, or moves quickly back and forth. The vibrating string makes the sound you hear.

questions.text: You put your hand gently on a speaker while music plays. What do you feel?
questions.explanation: The speaker shakes, or vibrates, to make sound. You can feel these vibrations with your hand.

questions.text: You are in a room with no light at all. Can you see the objects in the room?
options: No, you need light to see them
Only if you close your eyes
questions.explanation: Objects can only be seen when light shines on them or comes from them. In complete darkness, we cannot see objects.

questions.text: Light is shining toward a solid wooden door. What happens to the light?
options: It is blocked and makes a shadow
questions.explanation: A solid object like a wooden door blocks light and makes a shadow. Light cannot pass through it.

questions.text: Which material lets the MOST light pass through it?
questions.explanation: Clear glass lets light pass through so you can see through it. A brick, book, and metal pan block light.

questions.text: A flashlight can be used to send a message in the dark by blinking it on and off. This is an example of using light to do what?
questions.explanation: Blinking a flashlight sends a signal, which is a way to communicate over a distance using light.

questions.text: How do a plant's roots help it survive?
options: They take in water from the soil
They keep the plant warm at night
questions.explanation: Roots take in water from the soil and hold the plant in place. This helps the plant survive.

questions.text: What body part helps a bird fly?
questions.explanation: Wings are the body parts that help a bird fly. Animals have parts that help them meet their needs.

questions.text: A baby bird is chirping loudly in the nest. Why does it do this?
options: To tell its parent it is hungry
questions.explanation: Baby animals give signals, like chirping, so their parents know they need help, such as food.

questions.text: A puppy usually looks like which of these?
questions.explanation: Young animals look a lot like their parents. A puppy looks like its dog parents, though not exactly the same.

questions.text: Which is TRUE about baby animals and their parents?
options: They look exactly the same in every way
They are alike but not exactly the same
questions.explanation: Young plants and animals are alike, but not exactly the same as their parents. There are small differences.

questions.text: Where do we see the Sun during the daytime?
questions.explanation: During the day, the Sun appears in the sky. It rises in the morning and sets in the evening in a regular pattern.

questions.text: When can you usually see the stars?
questions.explanation: Stars can be seen at night when the sky is dark. During the day, the bright Sun makes them hard to see.

questions.text: In which season are the days the LONGEST, with the most daylight?
options: The days are always the same
questions.explanation: In summer there is more daylight, so the days are longest. In winter the days are shortest. This is a seasonal pattern.

questions.text: It is getting dark outside earlier each evening. Which season is most likely coming?
questions.explanation: As winter comes, there is less daylight and it gets dark earlier. Daylight follows a pattern through the year.
